questions.q_en: M and N are running on a circular track of length 1.8 km. Speed of A is 50 m/s and speed of B is 40 m/s. They start from the same point at the same time in the opposite direction. After how much time will they meet for the 2nd time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 50 + 40 = 90 m/s

Length of track = 1800 m

Required time = 2 x (1800/90) = 40 sec

questions.q_en: At a bookstore, Meera bought notebooks for her 6 classmates for a total of ₹280. Some of them wanted ruled notebooks, while others preferred plain notebooks. A ruled notebook costs ₹40, and a plain notebook costs ₹50. How many plain notebooks did she purchase?
questions.solution_en:
Let number of plain notebooks bought be X then number of ruled notebooks be (6 - X).

Given that,

50X + 40(6 - X) = 280

50X + 240 - 40X = 280

X = 4

The number of plain notebooks bought is 4.

questions.q_en: In ΔABC, side BC is extended to D. Given that AC = BC and ∠BAC = 70°, find the value of 2.5∠ACD − 1.5∠ABC.
questions.solution_en:
In ΔABC, since AC = BC the base angles are equal. Let ∠ABC = ∠BAC = 70° .

Since D lies on the extension of BC, the external angle at C is:

  ∠ACD = ∠A + ∠ABC = 70° + 70° = 140°.

Compute the expression:

  2.5 X 140° − 1.5 X 70° = 350° − 105° = 245°.

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Find the greatest number that will divide 49, 147 and 322 to leave the same remainder in each case.
questions.solution_en:
We know that: If two or more numbers give the same remainder when divided by some other number, then their difference must give a remainder of zero when divided by that number.

So,

Greatest number that will divide 49, 147 and 322 to leave the same remainder in each case = HCF of (147 - 49), (322 - 49), and (322 - 147)

= HCF of 98, 273, and 175

98 = 2 * 72

273 = 3 * 7 * 13

175 = 52 * 7

HCF of 98, 273, and 175 = 7

Hence, required number = 7

Pipe A, pipe B and pipe C are three pipes that can fill a tank together in 12 hours and pipe C alone fill the same tank in 48 hours. Find the time taken by pipe A and pipe B together to fill the same tank.
questions.solution_en:
The capacity of tank = L.C.M of 12 and 48 = 48

The efficiency of pipe A, pipe B and pipe C = capacity of tank/ time taken = 48/12 =4

The efficiency of pipe C together = 48/ 48 = 1

The efficiency of pipe A and pipe B together = 4 - 1 = 3

Time = total capacity/ efficiency of pipe A and pipe B together

The time taken by pipe A and pipe B together to fill the same tank = 48/3

= 16 hours

questions.q_en: Two friends A and B started a business by investing ₹1,50,000 and ₹2,50,000, respectively. They agreed to distribute their earnings in the same ratio of their investments. After a year, the profit earned was ₹6,00,000. Each of them added ₹50,000 to their respective profits and invested in a different project. If this project gave a yield of ₹4,20,000, then A's share in the profit is:
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of profit share of A to B in the business = 150000: 250000 = 3: 5

Profit of A from the business = 600000 * 3/8 = 225000

Profit of B from the business = 600000 * 5/8 = 375000

Ratio of profit share of A to B in the project = (225000 + 50000): (375000 + 50000) = 275000: 425000 = 11: 17

Profit share of A in the project = 420000 * 11/28 = ₹165000

questions.q_en: Asha and Suman's mud forts have heights 9 cm and 16 cm. If the fort tops are at 25 cm apart from each other, then the distance (in cm) between two forts is:
questions.solution_en:
Height of Asha's mud fort = AB = 9 cm

Height of Suman's mud fort = CD = 16 cm

The length of CE = 16 - 9 = 7 cm

The distance between fort tops = AC = 25 cm

So, the distance between two forts = AE = BD = √(AC2 - CE2) = √(252 - 72) = 24 cm

questions.q_en: Pipes M, N and P alone can fill a tank in 45 minutes, 72 minutes, and 54 minutes, respectively while a tap alone can empty the tank in 180 minutes. If pipe P and the tap opened together and after 30 minutes pipe P is closed and M and N is opened, then in how many minutes will the tank filled completely?
questions.solution_en:
Pipe M alone can fill the tank in 45 minutes

Pipe N alone can fill the tank in 72 minutes

The tap alone can empty the tank in 180 minutes.

Let tank will be filled in T minutes.

A.T.Q

30(1/54 - 1/180) + (T - 30)(1/45 + 1/72 - 1/180) = 1

=> 30 * 7/540 + (T - 30) * 11/360 = 1

=> T = 50 minutes

questions.q_en: 6 liters of mixture is taken out and replaced with water from a container containing 30 liters of pure syrup. This process was repeated further two times. How much syrup is now left in the container?
questions.solution_en:
Suppose a container contains A unit of pure liquid and B unit of liquid and taken out and filled with other liquid after n operations quantity of pure liquid in the final mixture

= A(1 - B/A)n

By using above formula,

Quantity of syrup in the final mixture = 30(1 - 6/30)3

= 30 (1 - 1/5)3

= 30 * 4/5 * 4/5 * 4/5 = 15.36 litres

questions.q_en: A shopkeeper at a mom n pop store, marks up all his items at 45% above the cost price incurred by him. He sells all his items on credit and allows 15% discount to his loyal customers. In order to ensure prompt customer payment, he further offers his customers a 12% discount on the reduced price. If he makes a profit of Rs. 4230 by selling a laptop (prompt payment transaction) to Ms. Rinisha, one of his loyal customers, then the actual cost price of the laptop must be
questions.solution_en:
Let the cost price of the Laptop be Rs. X

Mark-up = 45%

Thus Marked Price = Rs. 1.45X

Successive discounts = 15% and 12% respectively.

Thus, Actual Selling Price = (1.45X X 0.85 X 0.88)

= Rs. 1.0846 X

Thus profit = Rs. 0.0846 X = Rs. 4230

or X = Rs. 50000.

Thus the actual cost price of the laptop must be Rs. 50000.

questions.q_en: In 10 years under simple interest, a sum of money becomes 5 times of itself. If the rate of interest per annum was increased by 20% but the time remains constant, then the same sum of money would fetch Rs. 160 more. In how many years, the same sum of money will fetch a total simple interest of Rs. 1500?
questions.solution_en:
Let the principal = P

Amount at the end of 10 years = 5P

SI = 5P - P = 4P

We know that,

SI = P*R*T/100

=> 4P = P*R*10/100

=> R = 40%

New rate of interest per annum = (100 + 20)% of 40 = 120% of 40 = 1.2*40 = 48%

Simple interest @ 48% per annum = P*48*10/100 = 4.8P

According to the question, 4.8P - 4P = 0.8P = 160

=> P = 200

Also,

1500 = 40*T*200/100

=> 80T = 1500

=> T = 150/8 = 18.75 years = 18 years 9 months

questions.q_en: Average of four consecutive numbers is 9.5. Which among the following number, when added to each number in the same order, the newly formed numbers are in proportion?
questions.solution_en:
Let the four consecutive numbers are: a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3

Then, 4 * 9.5 = a + a + 1 + a + 2 + a + 3

a = 8

Then, numbers are: 8, 9, 10, 11

Now, let the number added = n

Then, (8 + n): (9 + n) :: (10 + n): (11 + n)

(8 + n)(11 + n) = (10 + n)(9 + n)

88 + 19n + n2 = 90 + 19n + n2

Hence, option (d) is the answer.
